description: This PHP source file defines a controller class 'SaveTerminationReasonController' within the OrangeHRM PIM module. It extends an abstract Vue controller and handles the pre-render logic to set up the appropriate Vue component for editing or saving a termination reason, based on the request attributes.

classes.name: SaveTerminationReasonController
classes.description: A controller responsible for preparing the Vue component related to saving or editing a termination reason, based on whether an ID is present in the request.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component before rendering, choosing between 'termination-reason-edit' and 'termination-reason-save' based on the presence of an 'id' in the request.
